description: ComputedMap entry kind (#lzmatmode) is orthogonal to materialization strategy: a keyed map's entries are input SOURCES (EntryKind.source — always materialized, any strategy) or derived COMPUTEDS (EntryKind.computed — materialized eagerly, or lazily on first read). `spec.entries` gives each key's kind and canonical value. Under lazy, source entries are present at build (`lazy_present_at_build`) while computed entries stay absent until read; under eager, all entries are present. Reads are strategy-independent. Proved as source_entries_materialized_in_every_mode / computed_entries_deferred_under_lazy.
